user_query: I'm building a website and I want to scrape the Open Graph details of a given URL to get metadata like the title, description, and images. I also want the domain or organization name associated with the URL.

TaskList.description: Fetch the HTML content of the given URL to extract Open Graph metadata.
Parse the fetched HTML content to extract Open Graph tags for title, description, and images.
Extract the domain or organization name from the URL.
